ModMetaData.name: ISEKAI — Balanced Stats [Star Sky Mods]
ModMetaData.author: chupakobra6 | Star Sky Mods
ModMetaData.description: Control ISEKAI stat allocation, round out enemy builds and keep equipment upgrades in check. FEATURES • Balanced: shares new automatic points evenly across all six stats, keeping the cycle between levels. Existing differences, starting bonuses and manual investments stay intact. • By class: favours class stats while keeping the others growing, with weights of 3/2/1/1/1/1. Berserker’s overlapping affinities use 4/1/1/1/1/1. Available after choosing a class; Balanced can be selected beforehand, even with automatic allocation off. • Pets: Combat uses STR/DEX/VIT weights of 2 and INT/WIS/CHA weights of 1; Balanced uses equal weights. Automatic allocation is enabled by default for player pets, with a separate switch and mode for each pet. Rank-based starting stats stay intact; existing unspent points are also allocated shortly after loading if that pet’s automation is enabled. • Personal choices: modes and allocation progress are saved for each character. Changing mode starts a new cycle for future points without compensating for earlier differences. All allocation modes skip capped stats. • Enemy builds: fresh hostile humanoids and creatures use a more rounded combat spread, preserving their full stat-point budget, rank and level. Select Balanced or original ISEKAI distribution separately for each. Existing characters are not rerolled. • Equipment refinement: combat and movement bonuses start at 50% strength, total apparel movement is capped at +20%, and material costs are doubled. Tune each value or restore original behavior. Equipment keeps its recorded upgrade levels. HOW TO USE Mode buttons sit beside the automatic-allocation checkbox in the main ISEKAI tab. The compact controls follow the active ISEKAI or vanilla interface style. Pets’ nested stats window remains available for manual allocation. RimWorld’s Mod Settings lets you toggle improved colonist allocation and pet allocation separately, choose default modes for characters without a saved personal choice, choose whether new or unconfigured pets start with automation enabled, and hide mode-change messages. Both features are enabled by default. Balanced is the default for colonists; Combat is the default for pets. Turning off improved colonist allocation restores ISEKAI’s original algorithm. Pausing pet allocation preserves unspent points. Global switches and changed defaults do not overwrite saved personal choices. Enemy and equipment balance is enabled by default. Humanoids follow ISEKAI’s role-generation setting; hostile creatures change only at first initialization. Refinement settings affect existing equipment too, while rune effects, durability and upgrade success chances stay unchanged. The scrollable settings window offers separate controls and buttons for recommended or original enemy/equipment balance, without resetting colonist and pet choices. COMPATIBILITY Requires RimWorld 1.6, Harmony (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2009463077) and ISEKAI RPG LEVELING (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3657580708). Load after these dependencies and any Guild/Creatures add-ons. English and Russian interface text is included. If using ISEKAI — No Auto Camera Jump (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3789336886), load Balanced Stats after it. For middle-click quest acceptance, use the separate ISEKAI — Quick Quests (https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3802965084) mod. Balanced Stats works without it. Can be added to an existing save. Back up before removal. Original ISEKAI files are neither included nor modified. FEEDBACK Found a bug or an inaccuracy? Leave a comment on the mod page or on Boosty.
